blockers.detail: Appendix Figure S3 defines the titer as end-of-growth; each of the nine fumarate isolate columns ends at 57 h and its ODmax equals that terminal value. This is a source reconstruction, not a direct laboratory timestamp.

Source methods recover MD20/20 g/L glucose, pH 5, 30 C, 180 rpm, initial OD600 0.1, and shake-flask sample handling, but Figure S3 does not identify which assay workflow produced each fumarate scalar, its replicate structure, or the flask geometry. See research/ale_source_process_alignment_20261015.json.

Inspected an open CSIC wine-yeast ALE dataset and a 2023 S. cerevisiae malate-to-fumarate study; neither exposes a matched replicate-level 18 h OD plus endpoint fumarate cohort for the frozen task. Search is not exhaustive.
Availability of the corresponding parental strain, HPLC/UPLC capacity and prospective culture capacity has not been documented.
Requires pilot estimates of biological variance, assay precision and a predeclared practically meaningful titer gain.

next_gates: Confirm development-process and assay details needed to reproduce the same Producer_F task at a fixed 57 h endpoint.
Confirm Producer_F stock/genotype availability and choose a calibrated, documented fumarate assay; record flask geometry and biological replicates before starting new populations.
Keep each early-OD feature and fixed-57 h titer linked to culture_id; timestamp sample collection, instrument measurement and result availability.
Acquire an independent cohort from new ALE populations with early OD and 57 h fumarate measurements; do not reuse the nine development isolates as external validation.
Use the prospective intake freeze stage before any external titer labels are available; later append endpoint measurements and verify against the saved receipt.
Freeze candidate predictions and selection decisions before any external titer labels are available; do not refit or recalibrate on that cohort.
Use pilot variance, assay precision and a prespecified practical gain to power the independent reculture confirmation.
